signals.title: CHF/JPY — G10 Bilateral Theme + Monetary Divergence
signals.text: CHF 1W average performance across 6 peer pairs prints at +0.649% while JPY lags the G10 complex at -0.782% across 7 pairs, driving a 1.432% bilateral spread. Spot CHF/JPY trades at 191.69, holding above key intraday support. The underlying divergence reflects acute policy mechanics: SNB policy rate sits at 0.00% with SARON at -0.04% while BoJ policy rate is 1.25% with TONA at 0.98%, establishing a 125bp nominal policy spread and a -102bp OIS carry advantage favoring JPY. Despite JPY carry support, persistent JPY cross underperformance dominates amid broader G10 flows. Trade bias: Long CHF/JPY; bilateral divergence momentum overpowers negative carry drag. Catalyst: SNB policy meeting 24 Sep — hold expected. Risk: BoJ intervention rhetoric intensifies or global risk-off drives disproportionate JPY repatriation.

signals.title: AUD/USD — Positioning Extreme + Carry
signals.text: AUD leveraged funds net positioning expanded by +10,920 contracts WoW to +59,299 net long as of 15 Sep, sitting at the 97th percentile of its 52-week distribution with z-score +2.11. This crowded institutional long aligns with RBA-Fed policy divergence, where RBA at 4.35% versus Fed at 4.00% delivers a 35bp policy rate advantage and a -50bp OIS carry spread favoring AUD. Spot AUD/USD trades at 0.7121, positioned below its daily SMA20 at 0.7166 but holding above its SMA50 at 0.7091 and SMA200 at 0.7017. Elevated positioning exposes the pair to unwind risk if technical support breaks. Trade bias: Long AUD/USD; policy carry supports trend but extreme spec positioning limits immediate extension. Catalyst: RBA rate decision 29 Sep — hike bias active. Risk: Close below SMA50 at 0.7091 triggers spec long liquidation.
evidence: RBA 4.35% vs Fed 4.00% — 35bp AUD carry premium

signals.text: USD/JPY 1M 25-delta risk reversal sits at -2.19 indicative mid, reflecting a heavy put skew that contrasts with CFTC data showing JPY leveraged funds net long +20,069 contracts after a massive +73,324 WoW surge to the 95th percentile. Risk: Sustained break below SMA20 at 156.70 accelerating put-option gamma unwinds.
evidence: Fed 4.00% vs BoJ 1.25% — 275bp USD carry premium

Spot trades at 0.5713, firmly below its SMA20 at 0.5842, SMA50 at 0.5856, and SMA200 at 0.5855 in a defined bearish technical posture. Fundamental yield mechanics reinforce downside pressure, with Fed 4.00% versus RBNZ 2.75% yielding a +125bp policy spread and a +110bp OIS carry advantage favoring the greenback. The heavy retail long overhang leaves the pair vulnerable to further cascading liquidation toward the 0.5700 handle. Trade bias: Bearish NZD/USD; contrarian retail long overhang accelerates downward momentum. Catalyst: RBNZ policy meeting 28 Oct — hike bias active. Risk: Daily close back above SMA20 at 0.5842 forcing retail short covering.
evidence: Fed 4.00% vs RBNZ 2.75% — 125bp USD carry premium

signals.title: EUR/USD — Macro Divergence + Technical Resistance
signals.text: EUR/USD trades at 1.1468, remaining pinned below its entire moving average cluster with SMA20 at 1.1587, SMA50 at 1.1542, and SMA200 at 1.1631. Leveraged funds hold net short -51,355 contracts (38.4% long share, 32nd percentile) following a -4,974 contract weekly reduction. Central bank rate structure firmly favors the US dollar, with the Fed at 4.00% versus ECB at 2.65%, generating a +135bp nominal policy differential and a +141bp SOFR vs €STR OIS carry spread. Options implied volatility prints at 4.7% against HV30 of 4.2%, yielding a subdued +0.5% volatility risk premium that reflects directional drift rather than stress. Trade bias: Bearish EUR/USD; structural USD carry advantage caps corrective rallies into moving average resistance. Catalyst: Euro Area S&P Global Composite PMI release 22 Sep. Risk: Close above SMA50 at 1.1542 neutralizing immediate downward pressure.
